campaign_created_rules: Campaign-created player characters require validated_creation_ref before campaign start.
Initial capability claims are derived from validated biography and evidence rather than selected directly.
Initial long-term objective may guide trajectory assessment but grants no capability.
rules: Definition bootstraps a character but is not live state.
Canonical characters are date-gated and never teleported into an era where they do not belong.
Generated characters must satisfy live-world assignment, species, faction and location constraints.
Presentation references do not grant gameplay authority or knowledge.
Species and culture never define personality automatically.
Once materialized, a generated or campaign-created character keeps the same character_id and identity lineage permanently.
A character may age, change appearance, assignment, rank, relationships and condition without becoming a new entity.
New visual assets for an existing character must resolve from the same base visual identity lineage.
Save/load, LOD transitions and generator upgrades may not reroll a materialized character.
